**Every new item, even on a busy week**

- **Nothing missed on a busy week.** LatestArr used to read only the 100 newest items from each source, shared across all of its libraries, so a big week of TV could push that week's movies out of the newsletter. It now reads everything added in the lookback window, up to 1,000 items per source.
- **Emails stay a sensible length.** A section with no **Most items per section** limit shows up to 100 items.

A "+ N more" line for sections that are cut short is planned for 0.13.0 ([#362](https://github.com/jshields-ca/LatestArr/issues/362)).
